suggestions.title: Write an email
suggestions.prompt: Draft a friendly project update email

replies.email:
Subject: Project update

Hi team,

Here is a quick update on our project. We have completed the initial review and are working through the next milestones. Please share any blockers before our next check-in.

Thanks for your contributions!

This is a sample draft. Add your project details before sending.
replies.react:
React components are reusable pieces of an interface. A component receives inputs called props and returns the UI to display. State stores values that change over time, such as a selected tab or message draft.

For example, a Message component can accept a sender and text, while a Chat component keeps the message list in state.

This is a preset demo explanation.
replies.plan:
Here is a sample workday plan:

09:00 — Choose your three most important tasks.
09:30 — Focus on the highest-priority task.
11:00 — Take a break and check messages.
13:00 — Work on your second priority.
15:00 — Collaborate and review progress.
16:30 — Record next steps for tomorrow.

Adjust these times to suit your schedule. This is a preset demo response.
